title: AW27 Women's Couture Materials and Details
summary: Couture materials for AW27 women: crushed and panne velvet, duchesse satin, lamé tweed, box calf and glazed leathers, faux fur with astrakhan looks.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- The Première Vision selection came out "silkier and more influenced by eveningwear codes" than expected: satins, crushed velvets and wool blends<sup>[1]</sup>
- Milano Unica: double-faced wool and cashmere, flannels and cashmere fleece ("Classic"); ripstops and ultralight nylon ("Freestyle"); lurex jacquards, sequin tulle, metallic velvets and lamé tweeds ("Romance")<sup>[2]</sup>
- APLF's AW27 leather directions run from raw, vegetable-tanned and waxed pull-up leathers to ultra-supple nappas and cashmere-hand suedes, glazed and moiré luxury leathers, and rubbery, holographic and laser-engraved experimental leathers<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Materials
sections.body:
- Panne and crushed velvet.
- Duchesse satin.
- Lamé tweed.
- Box calf, glazed and moiré leathers.
- Faux fur with mink or astrakhan looks.

design_implications: - Check fibre and animal-material rules per market.
